usedFor: Shopify is the store and Axiom is where you watch your data. “Order Cancelled” can run “Create Annotation”, marking the moment on your Axiom charts so a spike in cancellations has a visible cause.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Cancelled” in Shopify, then “Create Annotation” in Axiom
bestTemplate.why: The action marks an event on the charts of the datasets you choose, so a cancellation lines up with whatever changed in your logs.

watchOut: “Create Annotation” targets chosen datasets, so those need to exist first. “Create Dataset” returns the existing one if the name is taken, so it is safe to repeat.
